meta.title: Splint/strapping application, foreign body removal & nasal hemorrhage control — clean-room decision tables
meta.derivedFrom: splint-fb-nasal-cleanroom-spec.md (rule numbers cited per row as specRef)

semantics.rowLookup: Rows are evaluated top-down; 'when' is a conjunction of exact-equality tests on declared facts; a fact omitted from 'when' is a wildcard; the FIRST matching row wins; 'output' is opaque data returned to the caller. No expressions, no computation.
semantics.threshold: One integer fact banded into contiguous ranges by 'bands' (min/max inclusive, null = unbounded); the matching band's 'output' is returned.
semantics.unitCaps: Per-code maximum billable units per date of service; caps are absolute inputs to claim assembly, never computed.
semantics.docChecklist: All listed items are required documentation for the code; items are human-verified, not computed.
semantics.payerNotes: Free-text constraints surfaced to the human coder; never evaluated.
semantics.chaining: A matched row/band output whose flags contain 'proceed:<tableId>' transfers evaluation to that table (rowLookup or threshold alike); bare 'proceed' means the next code-emitting rowLookup in document order. An output with no proceed flag settles evaluation: its codes (possibly empty) are the emission.

outputConventions.codes: array of {code, units, modifiers[]} claim lines; empty array = no procedure code (E/M pathway per notes)
outputConventions.flags: blocking or advisory strings the caller must surface; 'blocked:*' means do not emit procedure codes

facts.name: device_type
facts.description: What was applied. 'splint' = non-circumferential rigid support fabricated from raw materials (plaster/fiberglass); 'strapping' = adhesive taping/compression technique (incl. Unna boot); 'cast' = circumferential cast (out of family, codes 29000-29086/29305-29450); 'prefabricated_orthotic' = off-the-shelf brace/boot/pre-packaged splint (application never separately billable). Spec A1/A2.

facts.name: body_region
facts.description: Region the device covers. Splint regions: shoulder_to_hand (long arm, immobilizes elbow), forearm_to_hand (short arm), finger, thigh_to_foot (long leg), calf_to_foot (short leg). Strapping regions: thorax, shoulder, elbow_or_wrist, hip, knee, ankle_or_foot, lower_leg_unna_boot (zinc-paste compression). Spec A1.1/A1.2.

facts.name: splint_mobility
facts.description: Static = no moving parts; dynamic = moving parts allowing controlled movement. Only distinguishes 29125/29126 and 29130/29131; 'na' for strapping. Spec A1.3.

facts.name: care_context
facts.description: initial_stabilization_referral = initial service without restorative treatment, only initial care expected (urgent-care stabilize-and-refer); replacement_during_or_after_followup = replacement device during/after the follow-up period; definitive_care_by_this_provider = this provider/group performs or assumes restorative fracture/dislocation/injury care (application bundled into the fracture-care code); dressing_after_procedure = device is a post-procedure dressing. Spec A3.

facts.name: same_area_musculoskeletal_procedure
facts.description: A CPT 20100-28899 or 29800-29999 procedure was also performed for the same anatomic area this encounter. Spec A3.6.

facts.name: fabricated_from_raw_materials
facts.description: The splint was created from raw materials (plaster/fiberglass/padding), not a pre-packaged device. Required for splint application codes; set true for strapping (constructed by nature). Spec A2.

facts.name: laterality
facts.description: Side(s) treated with the SAME device type+region. bilateral = same code both sides (modifier 50, one line, one unit for Medicare). midline_na for thorax. Spec A6.

facts.name: finger_count
facts.description: Number of distinct fingers splinted (units for 29130/29131, reported with FA/F1-F9 modifiers). Spec A6.4.

facts.name: payer_type
facts.description: Medicare Part B vs all other payers; drives bilateral claim format. Spec A6.2.

facts.name: em_separately_identifiable
facts.description: A significant, separately identifiable E/M (beyond the decision to apply the device) was performed and documented. Spec A5.

output.note: Fitting of an off-the-shelf splint/orthosis is included in its HCPCS L code; the application may never be separately billed (Noridian A56112). Bill the item itself where payable; E/M per its own merits.

Provider performing or assuming restorative fracture/dislocation/injury care bills the fracture-care code (with the E/M per global-surgery rules); the initial cast/splint/strap application is included.
Passes gate (initial stabilization+referral or replacement context); consult splint.regionMap. Q-code selection (body part/material/age) is a claim-assembly step outside these tables.

tables.note: Apply only after splint.gate returns 'proceed'. One application = one code, one unit (finger splints chain to count bands). Laterality/bilateral modifiers come from splint.lateralityModifiers; finger units use FA/F1-F9 modifiers instead. One invocation covers ONE device; multiple devices on different regions require separate invocations plus caller-side enforcement of the within-family PTP pairs (spec B2.1).

output.note: No dynamic variant exists for the long arm splint; mobility is a wildcard here.
Static documented (incl. thumb spica; sugar-tong mapping is open question 3).
Static vs dynamic is code-defining for 29125/29126 and undocumented — query the provider (A1.3); the tables do not default it.
Static vs dynamic is code-defining for 29130/29131 and undocumented — query the provider (A1.3).
Midline structure; bilateral-surgery indicator 0 — no laterality modifiers.
Unna boot includes same-leg ankle strapping (PTP 29580 x 29540); Medicare does not pay Unna boot supplies separately.

Device-type/region combination has no verified mapping (e.g., splint of thorax). Siblings out of scope: 29280 hand/finger, 29550 toes strapping (29220 low back and 29590 Denis-Browne were deleted from CPT in 2010/2013).

tables.note: Reached from splint.regionMap finger+static row. Units = distinct fingers splinted, reported with FA/F1-F9 modifiers, capped at the MUE (3). Cap duplicated from splint.unitCaps (no computation in the vocabulary).

output.note: Append the applicable finger modifier (FA/F1-F9).
One unit per finger with finger modifiers.
MUE (MAI 3) caps billable units at 3; the excess denies but is appealable with records.

tables.note: Reached from splint.regionMap finger+dynamic row. MUE for 29131 is 2 (MAI 3).

output.note: Append the applicable finger modifier (FA/F1-F9).

tables.note: Opaque modifier data the caller appends to the claim line emitted by splint.regionMap (not applicable to finger codes, which use FA/F1-F9 instead — see the finger bands).

output.note: Bilateral-surgery indicator 0; no laterality modifiers.
Finger codes use FA/F1-F9 per finger, handled in the count bands.
One line, one unit, modifier 50 (paid 150%; bilateral-surgery indicator 1). Two lines or 2 units exceed the MUE and deny.
CPT default; some commercial payers want LT/RT lines instead — check the contract.

E/M (office 9920x/9921x AND ED 99281-99285) reportable only if significant and separately identifiable; active PTP edits (mod 1) require modifier 25 on 99211-99215 and 99281-99285. The injury workup (exam, imaging review, treatment decision) typically qualifies.
Decision-to-apply E/M is included in the minor procedure (global 000).

required: Injury/condition treated (diagnosis) and anatomic site with laterality
Device type and materials (splint fabricated from raw materials vs strapping technique); static vs dynamic where applicable
Care intent: initial stabilization with referral (no restorative treatment by this provider) OR replacement during/after follow-up
Who applied the device; physician order and direct supervision if applied by staff
Neurovascular status after application
Supplies used (supports Q4001-Q4051 lines, non-OPPS)
If E/M also billed: separately identifiable E/M documentation supporting modifier 25
For 29580: compression indication (e.g., venous stasis ulcer/venous insufficiency) documented

notes: Fracture/dislocation-treatment CPT codes include cast/splint/strap application: a provider performing or assuming restorative care bills the fracture code, never 29xxx (NCCI Ch4 G.6/G.7). PTP edits (mod 1) enforce this across all fracture-treatment codes. Spec A3.

Initial-service pattern (stabilize and refer): E/M-25 (if separately identifiable) + application code + Q4001-Q4051 supply code(s); under OPPS the hospital reports the application code and supplies are packaged (NCCI Ch4 G.8). Spec A3.3.
Prefabricated/off-the-shelf splint or orthosis: application is never separately billable (Noridian A56112 names 29105-29131 and 97760); the L-code includes fitting. Spec A2.2.
Same-entity removal of the device is included; 29700-29750 only when a different entity applied it (NCCI Ch4 G.1). Spec A3.8.

Within-family PTP (all mod 1): 29105x29125, 29125x29130, 29125x29260, 29505x29515, 29505x29540, 29515x29540, 29515x29580, 29580x29540 — one device code per limb/region; different-limb pairs need 59/XS + laterality. Spec B2.1.
97597/97598/97602 (wound-care debridement) and 97760/97763 (orthotic management) as Column 1 bundle every family code (mod 1) — same-site combinations not separately payable. Spec A7.3.
64450/64451/64454 x 29515/29540/29580 are modifier-0 edits (cannot be bypassed); 64455 x same is mod 1 — lower-leg splint/strap/Unna boot with peripheral-nerve-block injections denies. Spec A7.4.

Bilateral: modifier 50, one line, one unit (Medicare; bilateral-surgery indicator 1 for all except 29200=0); MUE 1/MAI 2 caps make 2-unit or 2-line claims deny. Commercial payers may want LT/RT lines. Spec A6 / open question 5.
ED E/M 99281-99285 carry active mod-1 PTP edits against every family code — this is the only family in this spec with ED-E/M edits; modifier 25 required. Spec A5.3.
Unna boot (29580): Medicare treats paste bandage supplies as included; debridement of the ulcer is separately reportable only as a distinct service (PTP mod 1 with 97597/97598). Spec A7.2/A7.3.
Elastic-bandage-only wraps and buddy-taping have no verified mapping (open questions 6/7): conservative default is E/M only.
S9088/99051 urgent-care add-on codes are commercial-payer conventions, outside Medicare rules. Spec open question 12.

facts.name: fb_site
facts.description: Where the foreign body lies. Site-specific codes take precedence over the subcutaneous pair; deeper than subcutaneous (fascia/muscle) exits to musculoskeletal site codes. Spec A8.1/A8.2.

facts.name: removal_accomplished
facts.description: The foreign body was actually removed by the provider (not expelled by nose-blowing, not a failed attempt). Spec A10.2 / open question 8.

facts.name: incision_made
facts.description: An incision was made to remove the subcutaneous FB. Mandatory for 10120/10121; grasp-and-pull removal without incision is E/M only. Spec A9.1.

facts.name: wound_infection
facts.description: Wound infection present at the FB site. Complicating factor for 10121. Spec A9.3.

facts.name: scarring_or_delayed_presentation
facts.description: Scarring in the area or delayed presentation/treatment. Complicating factor for 10121. Spec A9.3.

facts.name: extensive_exploration_or_debridement
facts.description: Extensive exploration/dissection to localize the FB, or debridement required (incl. imaging-assisted localization). Complicating factor for 10121. Spec A9.3.

facts.name: distinct_fb_count
facts.description: Number of distinct subcutaneous FBs removed through separate incisions (units for 10120/10121, within MUE). Spec A9.4 / open question 2.
facts.note: Whether multiple FBs should instead escalate a simple removal to 10121 is unsettled (secondary sources list 'multiple foreign bodies' as a complicating factor while the MUE of 3 supports units); these tables use units and surface the tension in fbr.payerNotes.

facts.name: general_anesthesia
facts.description: General anesthesia was required (ear: 69205; nose: 30310). Moderate sedation is NOT general anesthesia. Spec A10.3/A11.2.

facts.name: slit_lamp_used
facts.description: Corneal FB removal performed at the slit lamp (code-defining for 65222 vs 65220; must be documented). Spec A12.1.

facts.name: conjunctival_depth
facts.description: Conjunctival FB: superficial (65205) vs embedded/subconjunctival/scleral nonperforating incl. concretions (65210). Adjacent codes. Spec A12.2.

facts.name: laterality
facts.description: Side for ear/eye codes (bilateral-surgery indicator 1). 'na' for subcutaneous/nasal. Spec A11.4/A12.4.

facts.name: em_separately_identifiable
facts.description: A significant, separately identifiable E/M beyond the decision to remove the FB was performed and documented (for the eye codes: an exam performed solely to confirm the need for the removal does NOT qualify). Spec A13.

output.note: No completed removal (expelled by blowing, not retrieved, referred out): E/M only. Reduced-services billing of a substantial failed attempt (mod 52/53) is payer-dependent — open question 8.
FB in fascia/muscle or deeper: code by site from the musculoskeletal system (e.g., 20520/20525, 23333, 27087, 28190-28193).
Removal requiring general anesthesia (typically OR). 10-day global.
Instrumented office-type removal only (A10.1); no laterality modifiers (bilateral indicator 0). 10-day global: related follow-up within 10 days is bundled.
Grasp/tweezer removal without incision is part of the E/M — document the removal inside the E/M note.

tables.note: Any one complicating factor -> complicated (10121). CPT/CMS give no official definition of 'complicated' (open question 2) — these factors are secondary-source consensus; the note must state the factor and the word 'complicated'.
Units = distinct FBs removed through separate incisions, capped at the MUE (3). Cap duplicated from fbr.unitCaps.

output.note: MUE (MAI 3) caps billable units at 3; the excess denies but is appealable with records.

tables.note: Units = distinct complicated removals via separate incisions, capped at the MUE (2). Cap duplicated from fbr.unitCaps.

Never add cerumen codes 69209/69210 for the same ear/session (PTP mod-1 misuse edits; wax clearance to reach the FB is included). 69205 requires GENERAL anesthesia — moderate sedation does not qualify (mod-0 edits vs 99151-99153).

output.note: One line, one unit, modifier 50 (bilat indicator 1); MUE 1/MAI 2 is absolute — never 2 units.

tables.note: One corneal code per eye per session (PTP 65222 x 65220, mod 1, code-definition). Multiple FBs in the same eye = one unit (MUE 1); use modifier 22 with documentation for substantially increased work.

output.note: Bilateral corneal FBs (rare): modifier 50, one line, one unit.

tables.note: Adjacent codes (out of the observed production scope but required for a complete eye gate). 65205/65210 carry ZERO NCCI PTP edits in v323r0 (verified absence) — constraints are policy-only.

output.note: Active PTP edits (mod 1) bundle 99211-99215 into every family code — modifier 25 required. No ED-E/M (99281-99285) edits exist for this family, but the minor-procedure policy still applies. For eye codes: an exam solely confirming the need for the removal does not qualify.
Decision-to-perform E/M is included in the minor procedure.

required: Foreign body type and anatomic location (site + laterality where applicable)
Visualization method (direct, otoscope, slit lamp)
Instrument(s) used for removal
Anesthesia: none/topical/local vs general
Complete removal confirmed; post-removal exam of the site
If E/M also billed: separately identifiable E/M documentation supporting modifier 25
Incision made — location, length, instrument (no incision = E/M only)
Subcutaneous depth (not fascia/muscle or deeper)
Retrieval method and closure/disposition
If units > 1: each distinct FB and its separate incision documented
Incision made (as for 10120)
The complicating factor(s) stated concretely: infection, scarring, delayed presentation, extensive exploration/dissection, debridement, imaging-assisted localization
The word 'complicated' in the procedure documentation
True intranasal foreign body identified (object described)
Actual instrumented removal performed (e.g., bayonet forceps under direct visualization) — expulsion by nose-blowing alone is E/M only
Office setting, no general anesthesia
External-auditory-canal location; which ear
Otoscopic (or equivalent) visualization and instrumentation (forceps/hook/spoon/suction; irrigation or immobilizing agent if used)
No general anesthesia
Cerumen removal same ear NOT separately coded (bundled)
Corneal location; which eye
Slit-lamp use explicitly documented
Visual acuity and anterior-segment exam findings
If E/M billed: exam purpose beyond confirming the need for the removal

notes: Incision is mandatory for 10120/10121; no-incision removal is E/M only — there is no PTP edit enforcing this, the engine must. Spec A9.1.

'Complicated' (10121) has no CPT/CMS definition; factor list is secondary consensus. Multiple FBs: these tables bill 10120 units per separate incision (MUE 3 supports units) but some secondary sources treat multiple FBs as grounds for 10121 — surfaced as an advisory; verify payer policy. Spec open question 2.
Deeper-than-subcutaneous FBs exit to musculoskeletal codes; PTP makes those codes Column 1 over 10120/10121. Spec A8.2.
30300 and 30310 have 10-day globals (unusual for this family): related visits within 10 days are bundled (99024 tracking only). 69205 also has a 10-day global. Spec B8.
69200/69205 bundle cerumen removal 69209/69210 (mod 1 'misuse'); 69205 requires general anesthesia — moderate sedation 99151-99153 carries mod-0 mutually-exclusive edits. Spec A11.2/A11.3.

65222 x 65220 is a mod-1 code-definition edit: one corneal code per eye per session; 65275 (corneal laceration repair) and 65430/65435/65436 (scraping/epithelium removal) conflict with the corneal FBR codes ipsilateral (NCCI Ch8 D.22). Spec A12.3.
65205/65210 carry no PTP edits at all in v323r0 (verified absence).
PTP: every family code x 99211-99215 is an active mod-1 edit (modifier 25 required); NO ED-E/M 99281-99285 edits exist for this family (policy still applies). Spec A13.2.
Eye/ear codes are unilateral (bilateral indicator 1): RT/LT; true bilateral = modifier 50, one line, one unit. 69200's MUE is MAI 2 (absolute). Spec A11.4/A12.4.
Multiple corneal FBs same eye = one unit; consider modifier 22 with documentation (AAO). Rust-ring handling unverified — open question 10. Spec A12.4.

facts.name: procedure_induced_bleeding
facts.description: The bleeding is due to a nasal/sinus endoscopic procedure or other nasal procedure at this encounter (control is bundled; modifier 78 if a postoperative bleed requires return to the OR). Spec A19.1.

facts.name: endoscope_required_for_control
facts.description: An endoscope was required to control the bleeding (not merely for visualization) — routes to 31238, out of family. Spec A19.2.

facts.name: posterior_control
facts.description: A posterior bleeding source was treated with posterior nasal pack (balloon/Foley/formal pack) and/or cautery. Spec A17.1.

facts.name: posterior_sequence
facts.description: initial = first control of this posterior bleed (30905); subsequent = repeat control after a prior initial control, typically a later date (30906). 'na' when no posterior control. Spec A17.3.

facts.name: left_anterior_extent
facts.description: Anterior control work on the LEFT side. temporary_pledget_only = anesthetic/decongestant material placed briefly to find the site, removed, no cautery, no packing left (E/M only). limited = limited cautery and/or packing, single site readily controlled (30901). extensive = extensive cautery and/or packing: multiple sites, repeated cautery, layered/multiple/deeper packing, anterior tampon/balloon, prolonged effort (30903). Spec A15/A16.

facts.name: right_anterior_extent
facts.description: Anterior control work on the RIGHT side. Same semantics as left_anterior_extent. Spec A15/A16.

facts.name: payer_type
facts.description: Medicare Part B vs all other payers; drives bilateral claim format for the anterior codes. Spec A18.

facts.name: em_separately_identifiable
facts.description: A significant, separately identifiable E/M (workup beyond the control procedure: vitals, anticoagulation review, source assessment documented separately) was performed. Spec A19.3.

output.note: Control of bleeding due to a nasal/sinus endoscopic or other nasal procedure is not separately reportable; a postoperative bleed requiring return to the OR is reported with modifier 78 (human coder decision).
Resolved with pressure/ice or spontaneously; no cautery, no packing left.
Material placed briefly to identify the site, removed, no cautery, no packing left in place -> E/M only.

tables.note: Posterior control emits ONE code, one unit, NO laterality/50 modifiers (bilateral-surgery indicator 2: already priced for the posterior field). Same-side anterior work is included (PTP 30905 x 30901/30903, mod 1); a separately documented CONTRALATERAL anterior control may be added by the human coder with 59/XS + LT/RT — surfaced as an advisory because the tables do not capture the posterior side.

output.note: Subsequent control of a previously controlled posterior bleed. Same-session initial+subsequent is mutually exclusive (PTP mod 1); a distinct same-day encounter needs XE.
posterior_control=true requires posterior_sequence initial or subsequent.

tables.note: Reached only when no posterior control and at least one side has limited/extensive work. One code per side; same-side hierarchy is structural (each side yields exactly one extent). 'temporary_pledget_only' codes nothing for that side (same as 'none' here).

output.note: Bilateral: one line, modifier 50, one unit (150%; bilat indicator 1; MUE 1/MAI 3).
CPT default; some commercial payers want LT/RT lines or 2 units — see payerNotes.
Different work per side: both codes with laterality; XS/59 on the lesser code per payer preference (PTP 30903 x 30901 is mod 1).
Active PTP edits (mod 1) bundle 99211-99215 into all four codes — modifier 25 required; no ED-E/M edits exist (policy still applies).
Decision-to-perform E/M is included in the minor procedure (global 000).

required: Side(s) treated; anterior vs posterior bleeding source
Method: cautery agent/type and/or packing material and type
Whether packing was LEFT IN PLACE after the encounter (temporary diagnostic pledget alone is E/M only)
Post-control status (bleeding controlled)
If E/M also billed: separately identifiable workup (vitals, anticoagulation review, source assessment) supporting modifier 25
The extensive element(s) stated concretely: multiple bleeding sites, repeated cautery applications, layered/multiple/deeper packing, anterior tampon/balloon device, prolonged or difficult control
Posterior bleeding source identified
Posterior pack/balloon type (posterior balloon, Foley-type, formal posterior pack) and/or cautery
Initial control of this bleed
Prior initial control of the same posterior bleed (date referenced)
Recurrent bleeding and the repeat pack/cautery performed

notes: One same-side hemorrhage-control code per encounter; hierarchy 30905 > 30903 > 30901 (PTP mod-1 'more extensive' edits). Anterior + posterior same side = 30905 only. Spec A17.
30901/30903 x 30906 and 30905 x 30906 are mutually exclusive (mod 1): initial and subsequent codes never together in one session. Spec A17.3.

'Extensive' vs 'limited' has no official definition; criteria are secondary consensus. Anterior tampon/balloon devices are usually 'extensive' (30903), but one AAPC answer maps a Rhino Rocket to 30905 — device POSITION (anterior vs posterior) must decide. Spec open question 1.

Bilateral anterior (Medicare): modifier 50, one line, one unit at 150% (bilat indicator 1); MUE 1 makes 2-unit claims deny. Commercial payers vary (LT/RT lines or 2 units with 50) — check the contract. Spec A18.1.
30905/30906 have bilateral-surgery indicator 2: never modifier 50, never 2 units — the fee already covers the posterior field. Spec A18.2.
Temporary anesthetic/decongestant pledget to locate the site, removed, no cautery, no packing left -> E/M only. Spec A15.1.
Packing removal at a later visit is part of that visit's E/M — no procedure code (and never 30300). All four codes are global 000, so the later visit is billable on its own merits. Spec A17.4.

Bleeding control due to a nasal/sinus endoscopic or other nasal procedure is bundled (NCCI Ch5 C.5); return-to-OR postoperative bleeds use modifier 78. Endoscope-dependent control is 31238, and 31231/FESS/ligation codes all bundle the 3090x family (mod 1). Spec A19.
PTP: all four codes x 99211-99215, mod 1 — modifier 25 required on same-day established office E/M; no ED-E/M edits exist. Spec A19.3.
